### type Path

```go
type Path []Segment
```

Path is an EPATH: a sequence of segments addressing an object, an attribute, a symbol, a route or a connection.

Message Router requests, route paths and connection paths are padded EPATHs: 16- and 32-bit logical values, port segments and symbols are aligned on 16-bit words with pad octets. EDS files use packed EPATHs.

### type Reader

```go
type Reader struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

Reader decodes little-endian CIP values from a byte slice. It never reads past the slice: the first read that would fails sets a sticky error, ErrTruncated, and every further read returns zero values. Check Err once after a sequence of reads.

Byte slices returned by a Reader alias the input; copy them to keep them.

```go
func (r Request) Encode() ([]byte, error)
```

Encode returns the encoding of the request: service, path size in words, padded path, data.

```go
func (r Request) String() string
```

String returns for example "Get\_Attribute\_Single @1/1/7".

### type Response

```go
type Response struct {
	// Service is the service of the request; the reply bit is removed
	// when decoding and added when encoding.
	Service Service
	// Status is the general status.
	Status GeneralStatus
	// Extended is the additional status, at most 255 words.
	Extended []uint16
	// Data is the response data.
	Data []byte
}
```

Response is an explicit message response.

#### func DecodeResponse

```go
func DecodeResponse(b []byte) (Response, error)
```

DecodeResponse decodes a response. The data aliases b.

#### func ErrorResponse

```go
func ErrorResponse(req Request, st GeneralStatus, ext ...uint16) Response
```

ErrorResponse returns a response to req with status st and optional additional status words.

#### func (Response) AppendTo

```go
func (r Response) AppendTo(b []byte) ([]byte, error)
```

AppendTo appends the encoding of the response to b.

#### func (Response) Encode

```go
func (r Response) Encode() ([]byte, error)
```

Encode returns the encoding of the response: service with the reply bit, reserved octet, general status, additional status size in words, additional status, data.

```go
func (r Response) OK() bool
```

### type Segment

```go
type Segment interface {
	// String describes the segment, for example "class 0x04".
	String() string

}
```

Segment is one segment of an EPATH: a [PortSegment](#type-portsegment), [LogicalSegment](#type-logicalsegment), [KeySegment](#type-keysegment), [SymbolSegment](#type-symbolsegment), [DataSegment](#type-datasegment) or [NetworkSegment](#type-networksegment). The set is closed.

### type Service

```go
type Service uint8
```

Service is a CIP service code, without the reply bit (0x80). Codes 0x00 to 0x31 are common services with one meaning everywhere; codes 0x32 to 0x4A are reserved; codes from 0x4B on are object-specific: their meaning depends on the class the request is addressed to (see [ServiceName](#func-servicename)).

```go
const ReplyBit Service = 0x80
```

ReplyBit is set in the service code of every response.

#### func (Service) String

```go
func (s Service) String() string
```

String returns the name of a common service ("Get\_Attribute\_Single"), the name of an object-specific service when only one class in the catalog defines its code, and "service 0x4C" otherwise.

### type SymbolSegment

```go
type SymbolSegment struct {
	Name string
}
```

SymbolSegment is an ANSI extended symbol segment (0x91): a tag name, or one member of a dotted tag name.

#### func (SymbolSegment) String

```go
func (s SymbolSegment) String() string
```

String returns for example "symbol MyTag".

### type TransportTrigger

```go
type TransportTrigger uint8
```

TransportTrigger is the transport class and trigger octet of a Forward\_Open: direction (bit 7), production trigger (bits 6..4) and transport class (bits 3..0).

```go
const (
	// TransportClass1Cyclic is a Class 1 cyclic connection (0x01).
	TransportClass1Cyclic TransportTrigger = 0x01
	// TransportClass3Server is a Class 3 application-triggered connection
	// to a server (0xA3), the connection of connected explicit messaging.
	TransportClass3Server TransportTrigger = 0xA3
)
```

Common transport/trigger values.

#### func NewTransportTrigger

```go
func NewTransportTrigger(class uint8, t Trigger, server bool) TransportTrigger
```

NewTransportTrigger returns the octet for a transport class, a trigger and the direction (server: the target is the server of the connection).

```go
func (t TransportTrigger) Class() uint8
```

Class returns the transport class.

#### func (TransportTrigger) Server

```go
func (t TransportTrigger) Server() bool
```

Server reports whether the direction bit is set.

#### func (TransportTrigger) String

```go
func (t TransportTrigger) String() string
```

String returns for example "class 1 cyclic" or "class 3 application server".

#### func (TransportTrigger) Trigger

```go
func (t TransportTrigger) Trigger() Trigger
```

Trigger returns the production trigger.
